heading: Reuse of the DS surface
text:
### Reuse of the DS surface [LTSL.1.3]

A `.dstest` reuses DS's own surface rather than introducing a second fact syntax.
Constructing a fact uses `emit`-style colon-keyword arguments; matching a fact uses
DS pattern syntax; a stubbed call uses the real `call <service> … as "<corr>"`
form. The construction-versus-matching split is [LTSL.4].
